sticker.title: Print QR stickers
sticker.hint: Deselect objects, pick the sheet format and print. Every sticker carries the QR code, the object name, the object number and the 112 notice.
sticker.loadError: The object list could not be loaded.
sticker.empty: No object selected — nothing will be printed.
sticker.reportCall: Report a malfunction: scan the QR code
sticker.emergencyNotice: For fire or danger: emergency call 112. This form is never an emergency call.

list.title: Objects
list.hint: All objects with search and filters. Edit and delete follow in upcoming packages.
list.loadError: The object list could not be loaded.

create.title: Create object
create.hint: Object number and name are required. Systems are optional and can be added later.

hints.objectNo: Digits, letters, _ and -, max. 32 characters (e. g. 12345_01)

errors.objectNoTaken: This object number is already taken.
errors.unknown: The object could not be created.

edit.title: Edit object {{objectNo}}
edit.hint: Change the fields and save. The object number cannot be changed after creation.

hints.objectNo: The object number is fixed after creation.

errors.objectNoTaken: This object number is already taken.
errors.unknown: The object could not be saved.

delete.confirm: Delete object „{{objectNo}}“? This cannot be undone.

errors.unknown: The object could not be deleted.

import.title: CSV import of objects
import.hint: The browser reads the CSV file and posts its text — the file itself is never uploaded. The first line is the header, comma or semicolon separated. Objects are compared by object number.
import.readOnly: Read-only: without object.import the file is not sent and nothing is imported.

errors.fileRead: The file could not be read.
errors.invalidRequest: The file was rejected: please check the header and the mapping.
errors.objectNoTaken: This object number is already taken.
errors.sessionInvalid: The session has expired, please sign in again.
